title: Made in Abyss — Before Philosophy Got Polite #Shorts
description:
Nihilism is not the conclusion of Made in Abyss — it is the floor you stand on while examining it. Made in Abyss (Japanese: メイドインアビス, Hepburn: Meido in Abisu) is a Japanese web manga series written and illustrated by Akihito Tsukushi. It has been serialized on Takeshobo's Web Comic Gamma website since October 2012, and its chapters have been collected in 15 tankōbon volumes as of August 2026.

Freud is not dead; he is simply no longer allowed to be the whole answer. It also won the 25th Spanish Manga Barcelona award for the Best Anime category in 2019. In 2023, the second season of the anime series was nominated for the 7th Crunchyroll Anime Awards in several categories, but did not win.
